items.html:
No defects found in the final Windows integer ABI patch.

  • Registered NumPy dtypes match all callback reads/writes, including integer volume outputs and lattice tails.
  • Windows uses 64-bit NPY_LONGLONG; Unix retains its existing NPY_LONG ABI. This agrees with rust-numpy’s mapping.
  • PyO3 extracts Windows Python integers through PyLong_AsLongLong. Checked label conversions and domain validation remain intact.
  • Tests cover real rotation values, int32/int64 promotion, output beyond 32 bits, and oversized Python/array labels without truncation.

Review was read-only; native Windows compilation and installed-wheel smoke tests remain necessary. Reviewed subset diff SHA256: 6811d5bc5a12b253fddf73ce8991d52487b7b626000d5f2003d8fdf4d5a5a662.
